pdf.code_page_intro: Your code is built from four research-backed parenting dimensions. Neither pole of any dimension is the better one.
pdf.care_title: 5 ways to come back to yourself
pdf.care_intro: Chosen from your style: what you spend yourself on is what needs releasing. Not one of these is for your child.
pdf.play_intro: One for each age range, so you can take the one that fits your child right now. Everything is already in your house.
pdf.skip_permission: No play today? You are still enough.
pdf.qr_hint: Scan to send the quiz to someone else
pdf.closing_title: Keep it, print it, or forget it
pdf.closing_body: This booklet has no targets and counts nothing. Take the one thing that helps and leave the rest.
pdf.care_story_1: There's an order most of us have backwards: everyone else gets looked after first, and you get whatever is left. But what's left at nine at night isn't you — it's the part of you that never got to rest.
pdf.care_story_2: The next five pages don't ask you to be a better parent. Nothing here is counted, nothing is reported, and not one of them is for your child. They're all for you, and they aren't a reward you have to earn first.
pdf.care_story_3: What's on them isn't random either. Every parenting style spends itself differently: some parents run out from anticipating, some from deciding, some from holding everybody's feelings. So whatever drains you most is also what most needs releasing.
pdf.drain_P: Anticipating. Your head keeps running even when your body sits down.
pdf.drain_F: Deciding without a rail. Every hour asks for a fresh decision.
pdf.drain_C: Steering. You're the one who always has to know the next move.
pdf.drain_G: Waiting and holding back. Following someone else's pace all day is work.
pdf.drain_T: Absorbing feelings. Your ears have been on shift since morning.
pdf.drain_D: Doing. Loving through action means you rarely get to sit down.
pdf.drain_E: Being the energy. Every bit of the fun sets off from you first.
pdf.drain_N: Vigilance. Everyone's sense of safety is parked with you.
pdf.care_howto: Take just one. If only one of these gets used this week, that worked. The rest stay here; they aren't going anywhere.
pdf.care_permission: No time this week? You are still enough.
